item.title: We take a look at the Mercedes Benz electric CLA built on a new EV platform – and it has a frunk
item.summary: We got behind the wheel of the new Mercedes-Benz all-electric CLA range which introduced the brands new modular platform for compact luxury vehicles. There are two models – the entry level rear-wheel-drive CLA 200 and the dual-motor, all-wheel-drive CLA 350 4MATIC.
